question: How do I reset my password?
answer: You can reset your password by clicking on 'Forgot Password' on the login screen and following the instructions sent to your registered email.

question: How do I change my registered email address?
answer: To update your email address go to Account Settings > Profile > Edit Email. A verification code will be sent to your new email.

question: Can I create multiple accounts with the same email?
answer: No each account requires a unique registered email address for security and identity verification.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: You can request account deletion under Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Account deletion is permanent after 30 days.

question: Why is my account locked?
answer: Accounts are automatically locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts to protect against unauthorized access.

question: How do I unlock my locked account?
answer: Wait 15 minutes for automatic unlock or click 'Unlock Account' on the login page to verify your identity via email.

question: How can I update my phone number?
answer: Go to Profile Settings > Personal Info > Phone Number and enter your new number. You will receive an OTP for confirmation.

question: Where can I see my past login activity?
answer: You can inspect active sessions and device history under Account Settings > Security > Active Sessions.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa Mastercard American Express PayPal UPI net banking and major debit cards.

question: Why was my credit card payment declined?
answer: Common reasons include insufficient funds incorrect CVV/expiry date or fraud prevention blocks from your issuing bank.

question: Is it safe to store my card details on your platform?
answer: Yes all payment processing is PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant and stored using end-to-end tokenization.

question: How can I download a payment invoice?
answer: Navigate to Billing > Order History click on your specific order and click 'Download Tax Invoice'.

question: Will I receive a payment confirmation email?
answer: Yes an automated receipt and tax invoice are emailed immediately following every successful payment.

question: Do you support automatic recurring payments?
answer: Yes recurring billing can be enabled for subscription plans under Billing > Subscription Settings.

question: Can I pay using two different payment methods for one order?
answer: Currently split payment between two separate payment methods for a single order is not supported.

question: What should I do if I was charged twice for one order?
answer: If a duplicate charge appears on your statement contact support with your transaction reference for an instant reversal.

question: What is your standard refund policy?
answer: We offer a full refund on eligible products within 7 calendar days of delivery provided the item is unused and in original packaging.

question: How long does it take to process a refund?
answer: Once approved refunds are processed within 3-5 business days back to your original payment method.

question: How can I check my refund status?
answer: Track refund progress in real-time under Billing > Refunds & Credits or via the link in your refund confirmation email.

question: Are shipping costs refundable?
answer: Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error or a defective item.

question: Can I get a refund if I bought during a clearance sale?
answer: Clearance items marked 'Final Sale' are non-refundable unless damaged or defective upon arrival.

question: What documents are required to claim a refund for a damaged item?
answer: You must provide your order ID photos of the damaged item and the shipping label within 48 hours of delivery.

question: Do you offer instant store credit refunds?
answer: Yes you can opt for instant Store Credit instead of original payment method refund for immediate store purchases.

question: What happens if my refund fails to process?
answer: If your bank rejects the credit our finance team will contact you to arrange an alternative direct transfer.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days depending on your delivery location and carrier availability.

question: Do you offer express or next-day shipping?
answer: Yes express delivery (1-2 business days) is available at checkout for eligible postal codes.

question: How do I track my order shipment?
answer: You will receive a shipment notification email with a direct carrier tracking link once your order leaves our warehouse.

question: What should I do if my package says delivered but I haven't received it?
answer: Check with household members or neighbors first. If still missing contact support within 48 hours to open a trace.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes we ship to select international countries. Shipping tariffs and import duties are calculated at checkout.

question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
answer: Address modifications can be made within 1 hour of placing the order via Orders > Modify Address.

question: What happens if I am not home during delivery?
answer: The courier partner will make up to 3 delivery attempts before returning the shipment to our fulfillment center.

question: Why is my order shipment delayed?
answer: Delays may occur due to severe weather carrier backlogs public holidays or incomplete shipping addresses.

question: How do I cancel an order?
answer: Go to My Orders select the active order and click 'Cancel Order' before it enters the shipping phase.

question: Can I cancel an order after it has shipped?
answer: Orders already dispatched cannot be canceled directly but can be returned using our hassle-free return portal.

question: Is there a fee for canceling an order?
answer: No order cancellations made prior to dispatch incur zero cancellation fees.

question: How quickly will my canceled order money be returned?
answer: Cancellations trigger an immediate payment release taking 2-4 business days to reflect on your account.

question: Can I modify item quantities in an existing order?
answer: Item quantities cannot be edited once an order is placed; you must cancel the order and place a new one.

question: What happens if a seller cancels my order due to stock out?
answer: If an item becomes out of stock you will be notified immediately and issued a 100% full refund plus a discount coupon.

question: How do I enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
answer: Navigate to Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and scan the QR code using your authenticator app.

question: What should I do if I suspect unauthorized activity on my account?
answer: Immediately log out all active sessions under Security settings and trigger a password reset.

question: How is my personal information protected?
answer: We adhere to strict GDPR and data privacy standards using AES-256 encryption for stored user data.

question: Will customer support ever ask for my password?
answer: No support representatives will NEVER ask for your account password OTP or full credit card number.

question: How do I report a security vulnerability or bug?
answer: Please submit technical security findings to security@example.com for evaluation by our engineering team.

question: Why did I receive a security alert email?
answer: Security alerts are sent whenever a login attempt is detected from a new location browser or unrecognized device.

question: The mobile app keeps crashing. How do I fix it?
answer: Ensure you have the latest app version installed clear app cache or try reinstalling the application.

question: Supported web browsers for the web portal?
answer: Our platform supports Google Chrome Mozilla Firefox Apple Safari and Microsoft Edge (latest 2 versions).

question: Why am I getting error code 500 on checkout?
answer: Error code 500 indicates a temporary server glitch. Please clear cookies and refresh your browser.

question: How do I clear browser cache and cookies?
answer: In Chrome press Ctrl+Shift+Delete (Cmd+Shift+Delete on Mac) select 'Cached images and files' and click Clear Data.

question: Why am I unable to upload document attachments?
answer: Ensure your file is in PDF PNG or JPG format and under 10MB in total size.

question: What are your customer support working hours?
answer: Our AI assistant is available 24/7. Human support representatives operate Monday to Friday 9 AM - 8 PM EST.

question: How long is customer support available?
answer: Our AI customer support assistant is available 24 hours a day and 7 days a week. Human support representatives are available Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 8 PM EST.

question: Is the support system AI or human?
answer: The online support system uses AI for 24/7 assistance. Human support representatives are available Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 8 PM EST for escalated cases.

question: How can I speak to a human customer support agent?
answer: You can request a human transfer anytime by typing 'connect me to a human representative' or clicking Escalate.

question: Where is your corporate headquarters located?
answer: Our global customer support office is headquartered in Tech Park

question: How can I submit product feedback or feature suggestions?
answer: We welcome feedback! Submit your suggestions via the Feedback button in your account dashboard.

question: Where can I view terms of service and user agreements?
answer: Full terms of service legal policies and user agreements are accessible at the footer of our web page.
